status: illustrative example with round numbers; not any real product; not verified
notes: Illustrative round numbers for a generic 36:1 planetary-geared actuator. Not a real product. Model values beyond the listed round numbers are assumptions (see 'assumptions').

assumptions.basis: reflected inertia not stated; 4e-4 kg m^2 per N m of peak torque assumed (order of magnitude for geared quasi-direct-drive units)
gear efficiency not stated; 0.90 assumed (single-stage planetary order of magnitude)
friction / backdrive torque not stated; 2 % of peak torque assumed
peak duration not stated; 2 s assumed
peak recovery not stated; 0.1 s of peak per s below continuous assumed
rating ambient not stated; 25 C assumed (common datasheet reference)
no curve published: straight voltage line through the rated point to zero torque at no-load speed; peak = min(peak, line)
winding temperature at the continuous rating not stated; the continuous rating is taken as the steady state that brings the winding to the derate threshold (105 C)
derate threshold not stated; 105 C assumed (class F/H wire with margin)
trip temperature not stated; 130 C assumed
trip reset hysteresis not stated; 5 K assumed
lumped heat capacity = 600 J/(kg K) x actuator mass (aluminium/steel/copper/magnet mix); an order-of-magnitude assumption
thermal time constant not stated; 300 s assumed for the housing (dominant) mode
winding-to-housing time constant not stated; 30 s assumed
share of the rated temperature rise across winding-to-housing not stated; 0.5 assumed
